from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

# Test 1: preview issue
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)
ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]
print('Before preview, len(db):', len(db))
result = w.preview(ops)
print('Preview result:', result)
print('After preview, len(db):', len(db))
print('Preview matches:', result == [1] and len(db) == 0)
print()

# Test 2: atomic issue
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w2 = BatchWriter(db2)
db2.insert({'x': 1})
print('Before atomic batch, db.all():', db2.all())
try:
    w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
except ValueError as e:
    print('ValueError:', e)
print('After failed batch, db.all():', db2.all())
print('Atomic check:', [v['x'] for v in db2.all()] == [1])
